name: logical_decoding_work_mem
description: Maximum memory per logical decoding session used for internal reorder buffers before spilling changes to disk.
symptoms: High disk I/O from decoding spill files
Logical replication lag under high change volume
OOM error during peak logical decoding load
tuning_tips: Increase this value to reduce disk spills and improve decoding throughput when memory is available; monitor 'pg_stat_replication' and decoding-related disk I/O to avoid over-allocation.
